the phagocytes of lamprey and goldfish are similar in their ability to internalize and respond to pro-inflammatory and homestatic stimuli, but that goldfish have evolved a greater sensitivity to pro-inflammatory signals and a decreased sensitivity to homeostatic stimuli.

phagocytosed apoptotic cells can induce homeostatic mechanisms in phagocytes that can attenuate pro-inflammatory responses, and this is a conserved mechanism that is present in jawed and jawless vertebrates.
